files.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original synthetic photo fixture for an Android photo-review app, not a UI or mockup. Create one realistic casual smartphone photograph of a quiet rocky Mediterranean shoreline on an overcast morning, gentle blue-gray water, pale stone foreground, a little natural coastal vegetation. Portrait 4:5 composition, natural exposure and fine real-world texture, no dramatic HDR or stylization. No people, no buildings, no personal objects, no signs, no text, no logos, no watermark, no phone frame and no interface. The entire image must be the single photograph.
